_doc: For finding a pose (docs/design/pose-picking.md). A pose is any <base>-<gesture>: that base (data/bases.json: legs, lean, tail; ground, use) and gesture (data/gestures.json: arms, chest, neck, head, mouth; hold, use), composed by src/compose.js; all side view (the front view is derived by the renderer). There is no list of poses: what a pose is for is its base's use and its gesture's use. tags: the story moments, each with the words that call for it in a scene line (word stems, matched at the start of a word). notWords: words that start like a tag word but aren't (Sita, ready …). wanted: poses the scenes ask for that don't exist yet, in the order to make them; until = what to use meanwhile.
_angles: Angles in degrees, as stored in data/bases.json and data/gestures.json and composed into a pose (the paths panels' adjust uses). Absolute 0 = down, +90 = forward (side view). Limbs are the character's own right and left; the side view shows the right side nearer the viewer, the front view (derived from the side pose by the renderer) faces the viewer, so the right side is on picture-left. spine.lean tilts the whole body forward; chest/neck/head are relative; spine.turn turns the head from the body's own front, + to its right (-90..90). arm.shoulder is relative to the torso's downward line, elbow flexes forward (0..160), knee flexes backward (0..160), ankle is the foot's angle from the ground, not the shin: 0 = flat with toes forward, + lifts the toes (-180..180). arm.hand: fist | out (thumb away from body) | in (thumb toward body) | point (like out, one long finger, shorter grouped fingers). mouth: 1 (slit), 2 (arch), 3 (wide shout). arm.out / leg.out: the whole arm or leg turned out of the paper, + = away from the body sideways (-90..90); side view shortens it by cos(out), front view shows its sideways reach. arm.twist: wrist turn; leg.toe: toe turn. arm.prop (optional, one hand at a time): a held sword, club or bow (kind) along its line through the grip; angle 0 = across the fist (the hand's angle + 90: the weapon out of the thumb side, at right angles to the hand), ±90 = along the hand; out is added to the arm's out; a bow with draw: true has its string pulled to the other hand; grip: both puts the other hand on the hilt below this one (the other arm's angles are then ignored).

stand.note: plain presence; turn the head with look, open the mouth with mouth

leapup-climb.desc: climbing a ladder or wall: both hands up on a high rung, one knee raised onto a lower one, body close to the rungs
leapup-climb.until: leapup-reachup on the ladder's stand anchors

stand-carry-overhead.desc: standing, both arms straight up holding something above the head

stand-pull.desc: leaning back, both arms forward gripping, as in pulling a rope or a person
stand-pull.until: stand-lean-back with both arms adjusted forward

sit-cross-legged.desc: seated upright, legs folded (throne, reading, teaching)

walk-carry-shoulder.desc: walking with a load on the right shoulder, right hand up holding it
walk-carry-shoulder.until: stand with the right arm adjusted

stand-embrace.desc: both arms forward and bent at chest height, to fold around another figure
stand-embrace.until: stand with both arms forward (shoulder ~70, elbow ~70)

lie-back.desc: lying flat on the back, arms at the sides or one across the chest (sleep, death)

sit-ride.desc: seated astride or on a chariot, legs down, arms forward holding reins or a bow
sit-ride.until: the Pushpaka: stand or sit on the chariot prop (on: chariot)

stand-carry-arm.desc: upright, one arm clamped round a figure carried against the chest, legs together (lifted into the air it is Ravana flying off with Sita)
stand-carry-arm.until: stepwide-swordcarry in view front, rotate 20, the head turned with turn 90; Sita beside him (arch-overhead or crawl-onhands) (06.05-06.07a)

crouch-ready.desc: deep crouch, knees bent, body gathered, arms back, about to leap
crouch-ready.until: bend-low (reads as searching the ground, not gathering: 08.05)

sit-hand-on-head.desc: sitting, one hand on the head (despair, heavy thought)
sit-hand-on-head.until: sit with the right arm adjusted (shoulder ~170, elbow ~140)

stand-clasp-hands.desc: two figures standing, right hands clasped (alliance, friendship)
stand-clasp-hands.until: stand with the right arm forward (07.05)

stand-arms-out.desc: standing, both arms thrown out, palms open (wailing, a complaint, grief)

sit-slump.desc: sitting on the ground, knees up, shoulders fallen, head low (hopeless)
sit-slump.until: sit with spine.chest 30-35, which reads as collapsing (08.04; problem-poses)

sit-carried.desc: carried on a shoulder or back: seated high, legs hanging, one hand holding on
sit-carried.until: sit with lift over the carrier, placed so the carrier's head stays visible (07.04)

walk-hand-on-head.desc: walking with one hand pressed to the head (searching in grief)
walk-hand-on-head.until: walk with the right arm adjusted (06.10)
